content.text: > 2 mo w toxicity, dehydration or no oral intake: parenteral third-gen cephalosporin (eg, ceftriaxone); cefazolin if local pathogens are sensitive; aminoglycosides (eg, gentamicin, potentially nephrotoxic) for complex UTIs. Blood cultures neg and good response: oral step-down (eg, cefixime, cephalexin, TMP-SMX, amoxicillin/clavulanate) to complete a 7- to 10-day course; an FQ only for selected children (eg, > 1 y w complicated MDR gram-negative UTI).
